title: Chinna Jameen
desc: Rasaiya, a wealthy yet naive man, is raised by his abusive uncle, who covets his property. However, when his uncle kills Rasaiya's lover Jothi, he resolves to avenge her death.

title: Thaye Bhuvaneshwari
desc: Prema, an ardent devotee of Goddess Soundarya, encounters an evil man, who forces her into submission. However, her belief in the Almighty stands unwavered.

title: Maharasan
desc: Selvi falls in love with Vadivelu, a butcher. Realising that Vadivelu has to get his sister married first, Selvi helps him find an ideal life partner for his sister.

title: Sabash Meena
desc: Sadasivam Pillai sends his son Mohan to his friend Appadurai to make him responsible. However, Mohan requests Sekar to take his place and meet Appadurai.

title: Thamizh
desc: Following an altercation with some dangerous goons, a man confronts a gangster and joins hands with his adversary to defeat him.
